page.overview:
What is Ilith's Group?

Ilith's Group was a splinter faction of the Ascendant cult that was established centuries before the Galactic Civil War to pursue a different form of research compared to the leader of the Bar'leth Group, Miril. The faction made their way to Pyrr IX where they built an Ascendant temple, which they modeled after the Ascendant temple on Bar'leth, and came to be led by Ilith. The faction were eventually wiped out by the Sith.
